# monotaur_maintenance_window (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur maintenance window by its ID, either a one-off window or one generated by a maintenance schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_maintenance_window" "db_migration" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the maintenance window to look up.

### Read-Only

- `apply_to_component_status` (Boolean) Whether the window's components show as under maintenance while it is active.
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the window was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the maintenance.
- `end_date_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) when the window ends.
- `exclude_from_downtime` (Boolean) Whether time inside the window is excluded from downtime in uptime reports.
- `maintenance_schedule_id` (String) The ID of the maintenance schedule the window is linked to, or null for a one-off window.
- `reason` (String) Why the maintenance happens: `ScheduledMaintenance`, `EmergencyMaintenance`, `MonitoringIssue` or `ExternalIssue`.
- `squelch` (Boolean) Whether alarm notifications for the window's components are suppressed while it is active.
- `start_date_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) when the window starts.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the window was last updated.
